This page compares [MOIRE](../tutorials/moire/moire_background.Rmd) effective COI with the simulated effective COI on the full MAD^4^HatTeR panel and on the 15-target panel. The simulated data are described in [Simulated datasets](../website_docs/data_simulated.qmd). The populations kept for the comparison are listed on the [benchmarking overview](../website_docs/benchmarking.qmd).

The parameter set is the one chosen for MOIRE on the [sample-level COI page](coi_sample.qmd). The reported summary is Lin's concordance, mean absolute error, and mean bias. Bias is the estimate minus the simulated effective COI.

```{r}
#| include: false
bench_src <- c("benchmark_data.R", file.path("benchmarking", "benchmark_data.R"))
source(bench_src[file.exists(bench_src)][1])
full_ecoi <- ecoi_results("full")
mini_ecoi <- ecoi_results("subselection")
```

## Full panel

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "MOIRE effective COI against the simulated effective COI, using the parameter set chosen for MOIRE on the sample-level COI page. The line is equality."
#| fig-width: 6.5
#| fig-height: 5.5
plot_ecoi(full_ecoi)
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  full_ecoi$metrics,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Lin's concordance, mean absolute error, and bias. Bias is the estimate minus the simulated effective COI."
)
```

## 15-target panel

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "MOIRE effective COI against the simulated effective COI, using the parameter set chosen for MOIRE on the sample-level COI page. The line is equality."
#| fig-width: 6.5
#| fig-height: 5.5
plot_ecoi(mini_ecoi)
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(
```
